messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-05-15, when ownership moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-05-15-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Ember team, which took over ownership from the Boreal team on 2025-03-03. [valid 2025-03-03 to 2025-05-15; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-03; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3]
- On 2026-04-08, the Atlas team observed that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2026-04-08 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-08]
- As of 2025-05-15, the pager for webhooks rings the Boreal team instead of the Ember team. [valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-05-15-webhooks]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-03, the pager for webhooks rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team. [valid 2025-03-03 to 2025-05-15; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
- A partner asked for webhook key rotation in their security review. [valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03]
- At the Boreal standup on 2025-11-03, it was decided that the webhook dispatcher will sign payloads with rotating keys. [decision; valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03]
- Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-07]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- The webhook dispatcher depends on the bus for outbound events, so it is down whenever the bus is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11-2]
- As of 2026-01-12, the billing API is owned by the Ember team, having been run by the Atlas team until then. [decision; valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-12-billing-api]
    earlier: The Atlas team owns the billing API as of 2025-06-09, when ownership passed from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to 2026-01-12; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the billing API as of 2025-06-09, when ownership passed from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-06-09 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the billing API as of 2025-03-07, when ownership passed from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2025-03-07 to 2025-06-09; recorded by handover/2025-03-07-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-07; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- The job scheduler is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-25, when ownership moved from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-scheduler]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- During INC-2026-003, the webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- Follow-up decision from the INC-2026-003 review: the webhook dispatcher will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one. [decision; valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- As of 2025-12-05, the reporting service is owned by the Ember team, having transferred from the Dune team. [decision; valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
    earlier: The reporting service is a Dune team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-12-05; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- The Dune team owns the reports pipeline as of 2025-03-20. [valid 2025-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-20]
